caption:
They say the neon rain washes away the memories, but it only makes my skin hum with electricity. 🌧️✨ I can feel the cold moisture clinging to my leather corset, a sharp contrast to the heat blooming in my chest. In this corner of the city, the autumn wind carries the scent of ozone and burnt copper. I move through the shadows of Sector 7, my pulse thrumming in time with the flickering signs. Every glance back is a gamble, every heartbeat a revolution. I’m a ghost in the machine, looking for a connection that isn't just digital. My skin tingles as I press against a damp, pulsating wall, waiting for a signal that only I can hear. The city is hungry, and tonight, I’m the one who holds the key.
